title: 克利夫兰（USS Cleveland CL-55） — original low-poly interpretation
author: navyfield project contributors
historicalApproximation: Original procedural low-poly interpretation from general historical silhouette facts; not an exact historical reconstruction, game asset extraction, or reproduction of any source artwork. Broad US light-cruiser superstructure, a tall rectangular bridge, two funnels, and triple gun housings recall USS Cleveland CL-55.
targetArmament: Three triple main mounts follow TARGET rather than the historical four triple 6-inch mounts. TARGET centerline anchor spacing supersedes historical turret positions.
references: TARGET ship name and general public historical facts about nationality, class, hull, bridge, funnel and armament silhouettes; no source artwork reconstructed.
numericFiringOriginNote: Main TARGET projectile origins are the numerical mount plus lateral barrel offset (z=0), not the physical tube tip. Muzzle markers sit at physical forward tips; gameplay must retain its existing numerical firing formulas. Auxiliary manual and automatic origins are also numeric simulation points, not these cosmetic markers.
